observations.meaning: Remaining prespecified ccRCC driver-panel genes for K4_C0001; none reach driver-panel significance.

observations.meaning: Limited display subset of non-driver-panel genes; every interpretation-matrix gene participates in q_global.

actions.reason: K4_C0004 has a coherent biological phenotype (VHL-mutant/PBRM1-wild-type with UV-response-down/Hedgehog/EMT programs), but biological identity does not establish independent membership. Evidence directly bearing on its boundary is unsupportive: set-level geometry shows essentially no within-versus-between distinction (CT -0.051, WSI -0.014, RNA 0.0003, WXS 0.044), and pair-level boundary evidence is weak against every neighbor — K4_C0001|K4_C0004 silhouette ~0.0005 with between-set affinity (0.00905) only marginally below within-set (0.00947) and an unexpressed boundary in fused geometry, K4_C0002|K4_C0004 essentially absent in CT/RNA/WSI, and K4_C0003|K4_C0004 only small-positive. The union of K4_C0001 and K4_C0004 is single-cluster dominated (candidate_k=1, leading eigengap 0.317), which is not evidence against merge but also provides no positive support for retaining the boundary. No merge is warranted because the pair evidence does not make one-unit representation more defensible than preserving units, and no split is supported. With membership independence unsupported and decision-relevant boundary evidence exhausted, K4_C0004 is not retained.

K4_C0001 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity: strong PBRM1 enrichment (OR 20.4, q_global 6.1e-07) with VHL enrichment and BAP1 depletion, plus coordinated down-regulation of oxidative-phosphorylation and immune-inflammatory programs. Its boundary evidence is weak but consistently positive in direction: set-level silhouettes are small-positive in all modalities (WXS 0.090, RNA 0.063, CT 0.003, WSI 0.003) with within-set distances marginally smaller than between-set in CT, RNA, and WXS, and the K4_C0001|K4_C0004 pair shows modest positive separation in RNA (0.050) and WXS (0.315). The pair structural diagnostic shows the K4_C0001|K4_C0004 boundary is essentially unexpressed (silhouette ~0.0005) and the union is single-cluster dominated, but this concerns the K4_C0004 boundary and does not by itself establish that K4_C0001's own membership is not independently represented; the set-level alignment provides the positive membership basis.
